difficulty.description: Configurable word-reading drill: class 1 uses 2 letters, class 2 uses 3, class 3 uses 4, class 4 uses 5. Letter count is a game setting, not a validated school proficiency standard.

proficiency.description: Recognizes Hebrew letters and decodes pointed words from two to five letters; not a CEFR rating or a phonetic assessment.

assessment.success: One whole-word transcript match after stripping niqqud and punctuation and accepting documented full-spelling variants, or explicit adult confirmation. Automatically returns success after brief feedback; the game owns rescue and gate rewards. No phonetic pronunciation scoring.

source.adaptation: Original HTML, styling, word bank and reading behavior retained; game completion bridge and adult fallback added.

wordIndex.description: Starting index within the filtered word bank; wraps around.
wordIndex.title: Starting word index

wordLength.description: Use the selected grade, or override the length for manual exploration.
wordLength.title: Word length

word.description: Optional exact word (with or without niqqud). Must be in the filtered word bank.
word.title: Exact word (optional)

sound.description: Enable optional success and retry sounds.
sound.title: Sound effects

allowAdultConfirmation.description: Offer explicit adult confirmation when speech recognition is unavailable.
allowAdultConfirmation.title: Adult confirmation

grade.description: Selected school class: 1 → 2 letters, 2 → 3, 3 → 4, 4 → 5. Used when wordLength is grade.
grade.title: Class level

compatibility.speechRecognition: Chrome recommended; availability depends on browser and device. Adult confirmation works without speech recognition.
